newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Tabacalera revises 1996 profit down.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Tabacalera revises 1996 profit down.

text.p: Spain's Tabacalera has revised its 1996 profits lower after reviewing the balance sheet value of real estate, the company said on Thursday.

After an audit, Tabacalera said it had to apply stricter criteria and made a provision of 2.514 billion pesetas charged over the 1996 balance sheet. The provision was intended to counterbalance an initial overvaluing of real estate holdings.
The tobacco producer pushed down its 1996 attributable profit to 11.73 billion pesetas from 13.46 billion reported in March.
Compared with 1995 profits of 14.03 billion pesetas, the revised 1996 figure was a 16.4 percent drop instead of the 4.1 percent fall reported in March.
